notes:
Supersedes impl/search-cli/thin-dispatch. The whole change is three lines inside query(): ask
phrase-matching for the ids a quoted segment allows (null when there is no phrase), rank as before,
filter, slice to ten. index and stats are untouched, and so is every error path.

Why filter AFTER ranking instead of ranking a restricted reader: idf is global that way. Restricting
the reader first would compute idf inside the candidate set, where a corpus-wide common word looks
rare, and would silently re-order the phrase results. The cost is asking rank() for docCount ids
instead of ten, which is free — rank sorts its whole hit set either way.

The gate runs the deprecated search-cli gate alongside the new one, so the old surface is enforced by
the assertions that always enforced it: ten ids one per line, stats' three keys, stderr + exit 1 +
empty stdout on every error, ./index resolved against cwd, and the composition-layer check (now
extended with lib/phrase.mjs, and with a check that no matching logic leaked into the CLI).
